description: Open and blocked nights for one property over a date range of up to 93 days. `minimum_nights` is the smallest positive `min_stay` value among calendar dates returned in that range. It is a hint; individual arrival dates may require more. This result shows which alternative dates are open but does not price or confirm a stay. An exact quote determines eligibility and price for a specific stay.

end_date.description: Last date to check, YYYY-MM-DD. At most 93 days after start_date.

name: get_availability

minimum_nights.description: The smallest positive min_stay value among calendar dates returned for the requested range. It is a hint, not a guarantee that every arrival is allowed. An exact quote checks a specific stay.

open_dates.description: YYYY-MM-DD nights that are open. They still have to satisfy minimum stay and arrival rules.

title: Get availability calendar
